title: selliguea chenopus
intro: Selliguea chenopus, commonly known as Chenopodium sel. or Chinese milk vetch, is a type of plant used in traditional Chinese medicine. This plant is known for its health benefits, which include treating conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Selliguea chenopus include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and diuretic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to fully understand its effects.
